description: Search FickelUSA custom promotional products (logo apparel, drinkware, bags, hats, pens and more). Returns up to 10 products with id, name, category, image, and — for most items — buy_url, the exact fickelusa.com product page where the buyer completes the purchase. FICKEL does not take payment. Screen-printed products omit buy_url and use request_quote because of the artwork. Use the id with get_product, buy_now, or request_quote.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 10, default 5).

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "travel mug", "embroidered polo", "tote bag".

name: search_catalog
title: Search the FICKEL catalog
